subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle Volcano Engine Lite or Coding Plan UUID-like keys when the selected model is a standard Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source and docs show one API-key setup spanning two endpoints, but only a credentialed vendor check can determine whether the right fix is routing, diagnostics, or shared-key runtime repair.

options.title: Validate the Lite contract first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys coding-only
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for Coding Plan, preserve the endpoint split and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics that guide users to `volcengine-plan` models.

options.title: Support shared endpoint use
options.body: If the UUID-like key should work on standard models too, fix the shared credential/header/runtime path and add regression coverage for the standard DeepSeek route.

recommendation.title: Validate the Lite contract first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across provider auth aliases, Volcengine catalog wiring, and compatibility-sensitive setup/runtime boundaries.
